confirmed_supergreens.title: Ireland – Computer support services – ICT services for the Operation and Maintenance of the Waters of LIFE Web Portal and Smart Phone Application
confirmed_supergreens.buyer: Department of Housing Local Government and Heritage
unknowns: SPM must confirm that its current insurance arrangements can meet the exact policy levels required by paragraph 2.21.1 or arrange compliant cover if awarded.

SPM must evidence a credible delivery team for the existing Go backend, web management dashboard and Flutter mobile application across the contract term; subcontracting/consortium is expressly available if specialist capacity is needed.
SPM must provide acceptable Irish tax-clearance evidence prior to award.
The existing system takeover and ongoing security/support obligations should be technically scoped before pricing to avoid underestimating maintenance effort.
confirmed_supergreens.why: This is a live, authoritative and unusually strong SPM-fit ICT maintenance opportunity. The DCE resolves the true tender deadline to 18 September 2026 at 17:00, while 11 September is only the query deadline. The contract is capped at EUR 80k, the turnover selection criterion is explicitly N/A, no numeric minimum prior-reference or named-certification threshold was identified, and consortium/subcontracting is permitted. The work directly covers a Go backend, web dashboard and Flutter mobile app with maintenance, security, bug-fixing, compatibility and testing. Bidder-specific insurance, tax and delivery-capacity evidence prevent FINAL_SUPER_GREEN but do not constitute an established hard blocker to GREEN.
